import { setup, assign, enqueueActions } from "../../../src/index.js"
import { agent, child } from "./support.js"
import { Option } from "effect"

/** Detect an erased contextual type. */
type IsAny<T> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? true : false
/** Require exact structural equality rather than assignability. */
type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false
/** A compilation failure identifies each mismatched type assertion. */
const exact = <T extends true>(): void => undefined
/** The setup's declared context. */
type Context = { count: number }
/** The setup's declared input. */
type Input = { start: number }
/** The setup's declared events. */
type Event = { type: "GO"; increment: number } | { type: "STOP" }
/** The agent setup provides contextual types to every inline form. */
const s = setup({ types: {} as { context: Context; input: Input; events: Event }, actors: { agent } })

/** A context factory retains the exact input type. */
export const factory = s.createMachine({
  context: ({ input }) => {
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof input>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof input, Input>>()
    return { count: input.start }
  },
  initial: "x", states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } }
})

/** A destructured action retains the exact context and event types. */
export const destructure = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 },
  entry: ({ context, event }) => {
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof context>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof event, Event>>()
  },
  initial: "x", states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } }
})

/** An assignment callback retains the exact context and event types. */
export const assigned = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 },
  entry: assign({ count: ({ context, event }) => {
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof context>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof event, Event>>()
    return context.count
  } }),
  initial: "x", states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } }
})

/** An enqueue callback retains the exact context and event types. */
export const enqueued = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 },
  entry: enqueueActions(({ context, event, enqueue }) => {
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof context>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
    exact<Equal<typeof event, Event>>()
    enqueue.assign({ count: context.count })
  }),
  initial: "x", states: { x: { after: { 1: "done" } }, done: { type: "final" } }
})

/** Nested callback arrays preserve types while all four forms occur together. */
export const nested = s.createMachine({
  context: ({ input }) => ({ count: input.start }),
  initial: "x",
  states: {
    x: {
      entry: [
        ({ context, event }) => {
          exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof context>, false>>()
          exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event>, false>>()
          exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
          exact<Equal<typeof event, Event>>()
        },
        assign({ count: ({ context }) => context.count }),
        enqueueActions(({ enqueue }) => enqueue.assign({ count: 1 }))
      ],
      after: { 1: "done" }
    },
    done: { type: "final" }
  }
})

/** An invocation completion callback retains its actor's exact output type. */
export const doneAssigned = s.createMachine({
  context: { count: 0 }, initial: "x",
  states: {
    x: {
      on: { GO: {} },
      invoke: {
        src: "agent", input: 1,
        onDone: {
          target: "done",
          actions: assign({ count: ({ context, event }) => {
            exact<Equal<IsAny<typeof event.output>, false>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof event.output, Option.Option<number>>>()
            exact<Equal<typeof context, Context>>()
            return Option.getOrElse(event.output, () => context.count)
          } })
        }
      }
    },
    done: { type: "final" }
  }
})
